claims.statement: They resemble a human head with long dark hair, "terrible eyes" and a large mouth of razor-sharp fangs.
claims.statement_id: Wujudnya seperti kepala manusia berambut gelap panjang, bermata mengerikan, dan bermulut besar penuh taring tajam.
claims.quote: They are generally described as resembling a human head with long dark hair, "terrible eyes", and a large mouth filled with razor sharp fangs.

claims.statement: In some versions it has bat wings at each cheek and bird-like talons.
claims.statement_id: Dalam beberapa versi, ia bersayap kelelawar di kedua pipi dan bercakar seperti burung.
claims.quote: In some versions, the Flying Head has a pair of bat wings jutting from each side of its cheek and bird-like talons.

claims.statement: In all versions it is larger than the tallest man, with a hide no weapon can pierce.
claims.statement_id: Dalam semua versi, ia lebih besar daripada manusia tertinggi dan berkulit yang tak tertembus senjata.
claims.quote: In all instances, they are described as being larger in size than that of the tallest man and possessing a hide that no weapon can penetrate.

claims.statement: According to folklore, the Flying Head drove the original inhabitants near the source of the Hudson River in the Adirondack Mountains from their hunting grounds before Europeans came.
claims.statement_id: Menurut cerita rakyat, Flying Head mengusir penduduk asli dekat hulu Sungai Hudson di Pegunungan Adirondack dari tempat berburu mereka sebelum orang Eropa datang.
claims.quote: the Flying Head drove the original native inhabitants who lived in the area  of the state of New York near the source of the Hudson River, in the Adirondack Mountains away from their hunting grounds before the Europeans came.

claims.statement: Smith writes that among the supernatural beings corresponding to good and evil genii were the Great Heads, with ever watchful eyes and long hair serving as wings to bear them on missions of mercy or of destruction.
claims.statement_id: Smith menulis bahwa di antara makhluk gaib yang sepadan dengan jin baik dan jahat terdapat Great Heads, bermata selalu waspada, dengan rambut panjang yang berfungsi sebagai sayap untuk membawa mereka dalam misi belas kasih atau kehancuran.
claims.quote: Among the supernatural beings corresponding to good and evil genii were the Great Heads, with ever watchful eyes, and long hair which served them as wings to bear them on missions of mercy or of destruction.

claims.statement: Smith records a common belief among Indians in a strange, human-like creature consisting simply of a head, made terrific with large eyes and covered with long hair.
claims.statement_id: Smith mencatat kepercayaan umum di kalangan orang Indian tentang makhluk aneh mirip manusia yang hanya terdiri dari kepala dengan mata besar yang menakutkan dan tertutup rambut panjang.
claims.quote: It was a common belief among Indians that there was a strange, human-like creature, consisting simply of a head made terrific with large eyes and covered with long hair.

claims.statement: According to Smith, the Great Head's home was upon a huge rock, a rifted promontory, over which his long hair streamed in shaggy fierceness.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Smith, kediaman Great Head berada di atas batu besar, sebuah tanjung yang retak, tempat rambut panjangnya terurai lebat.
claims.quote: His home was upon a huge rock, a rifted promontory, over which his long hair streamed in shaggy fierceness.

claims.statement: Smith translates the Great Head's growl on seeing anything with the breath of life as "I see thee, I see thee, thou shalt die," or "thou shalt suffer."
claims.statement_id: Smith menerjemahkan seruan Great Head yang melihat makhluk hidup sebagai "Aku melihatmu, aku melihatmu, kau akan mati" atau "kau akan menderita".
claims.quote: that is, "I see thee, I see thee, thou shalt die," or "thou shalt suffer."

claims.statement: In a story recorded by Smith, the uncle calls the Great Head an awful being who destroys those who go near him.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah yang dicatat Smith, sang paman menyebut Great Head sebagai makhluk mengerikan yang membinasakan orang yang mendekatinya.
claims.quote: He is an awful being, for he destroys those who go near him.

claims.statement: In the same tale, after helping to kill the witch, the Great Head departs, a terrific hurricane arises, and out of the wind he calls the nine brothers to awake, and they all arise to life.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah yang sama, setelah membantu membinasakan penyihir perempuan, Great Head pergi, badai dahsyat bertiup, dan dari dalam angin ia memanggil sembilan bersaudara untuk bangun, lalu mereka semua hidup kembali.
claims.quote: Great Head departed, and then arose a storm and a terrific hurricane, and the Great Head out of the wind called to the nine brothers to awake, and they all arose to life

claims.statement: In Cusick's story as given by Smith, a woman at Onondaga was parching acorns by the fire when one of the monstrous heads appeared at the door; thinking she was eating coals of fire, it disappeared, and none of its kind have been seen since.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Cusick yang dimuat Smith, seorang perempuan tua di Onondaga sedang memanggang biji ek di dekat api ketika salah satu kepala raksasa muncul di pintu; mengira perempuan itu memakan bara api, kepala itu lenyap, dan sejak itu tidak ada lagi yang terlihat.
claims.quote: An old squaw who resided at Onondaga was alone in her wigwam one evening. While sitting by the fire parching some acorns one of the monstrous heads made its appearance at the door. ... it suddenly disappeared, and none of its kind have been seen since that day.

claims.statement: Smith titles the story "Cusick's story of the dispersion of the Great Heads".
claims.statement_id: Smith memberi kisah itu judul "Cusick's story of the dispersion of the Great Heads" (kisah Cusick tentang tercerai-berainya para Great Head).
claims.quote: CUSICK'S STORY OF THE DISPERSION OF THE GREAT HEADS.

claims.statement: The Fresno nightcrawler is a cryptid said to originate in Fresno, California.
claims.statement_id: Fresno nightcrawler adalah kriptid yang konon berasal dari Fresno, California.
claims.quote: The Fresno nightcrawler is a cryptid said to originate in Fresno, California.

claims.statement: It is described as semi-humanoid, white and long-legged, usually seen in pairs.
claims.statement_id: Ia digambarkan setengah mirip manusia, berwarna putih, berkaki panjang, dan biasanya terlihat berpasangan.
claims.quote: It is described as semi-humanoid, white in color, long-legged, and claimed to be typically spotted in pairs.

claims.statement: They have been compared to "walking pairs of pants".
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini diibaratkan "celana panjang yang berjalan".
claims.quote: They have been compared to "walking pairs of pants".

claims.statement: According to Brian Dunning, it is an urban legend.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Brian Dunning, Fresno nightcrawler adalah legenda urban.
claims.quote: According to Brian Dunning, the Fresno nightcrawler is an urban legend

claims.statement: It was first popularized by 2007 CCTV footage from south Fresno aired on Univision.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini mulai populer lewat rekaman CCTV tahun 2007 dari Fresno selatan yang ditayangkan jaringan televisi Univision.
claims.quote: The Fresno nightcrawler was first popularized by CCTV footage shot in 2007 by a man in south Fresno, California, featured on the television network Univision.

claims.statement: When Michael Banti of Weird Fresno checked with regional tribes, they did not recognize the photographed sculptures as local monuments.
claims.statement_id: Saat Michael Banti dari Weird Fresno menghubungi suku-suku setempat, mereka tidak mengenali patung yang difoto sebagai monumen pribumi setempat.
claims.quote: when Weird Fresno founder Michael Banti contacted regional tribes to confirm their authenticity, his contacts did not recognize the photographed sculptures as matching local indigenous monuments.

claims.statement: It has become an icon of Fresno with merchandise and fans worldwide.
claims.statement_id: Fresno nightcrawler menjadi ikon Fresno dan melahirkan barang dagangan serta penggemar di seluruh dunia.
claims.quote: The Fresno nightcrawler has become an icon of Fresno, and has spawned merchandise and fans around the world.

claims.statement: According to Skeptoid, it looks like a pair of child-sized white sweatpants, pressed flat, walking around by themselves as if worn by some skinny invisible child.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Skeptoid, ia tampak seperti sepasang celana training putih seukuran anak, dipipihkan, yang berjalan sendiri seolah dipakai anak kurus tak kasatmata.
claims.quote: It looks like a pair of child-sized white sweatpants, pressed flat, and walking around by themselves as if worn by some skinny invisible child.

claims.statement: The story began in November 2007 when a man who gave his name only as Jose brought his home security videotape to the Fresno office of Univision, the Spanish-language TV network.
claims.statement_id: Kisah ini bermula pada November 2007, ketika seorang pria yang hanya menyebut namanya Jose membawa rekaman kamera keamanan rumahnya ke kantor Univision, jaringan TV berbahasa Spanyol, di Fresno.
claims.quote: The story got its start way back in November 2007 when a man who gave his name only as Jose ... brought his home security videotape into the Fresno office of Univision, the Spanish-language TV network.

claims.statement: In 2010, the paranormal TV show Fact or Faked did a segment on the video, and its hosts dubbed it the Fresno Nightcrawler.
claims.statement_id: Pada 2010, acara TV paranormal Fact or Faked membuat segmen tentang rekaman itu, dan para pembawanya menamainya Fresno Nightcrawler.
claims.quote: Then in 2010, the paranormal TV show Fact or Faked did a segment on the video. The hosts dubbed it the Fresno Nightcrawler

claims.statement: According to Skeptoid, the videos tend always to show a pair of them, one taller and one shorter.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Skeptoid, video-video itu cenderung selalu memperlihatkan sepasang, satu lebih tinggi dan satu lebih pendek.
claims.quote: The videos tend to always show a pair of them, one taller and one shorter.

claims.statement: Jose showed a visitor the yard where the video was taken, and it was clear the creatures had been quite small, no more than half a meter high.
claims.statement_id: Jose menunjukkan halaman tempat video direkam, dan jelas bahwa sosok-sosok itu cukup kecil, tidak lebih dari setengah meter tingginya.
claims.quote: Jose showed him the yard where the video was taken and it was clear that the creatures had been quite small, no more than half a meter high.

claims.statement: According to Skeptoid, the number of people who firmly and passionately believe the Fresno Nightcrawler must be an actual undiscovered species probably approaches zero.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Skeptoid, jumlah orang yang teguh percaya bahwa Fresno Nightcrawler pasti spesies yang belum ditemukan mungkin mendekati nol.
claims.quote: The number of people who firmly and passionately believe that the Fresno Nightcrawler must represent an actual undiscovered species probably approaches zero.

claims.statement: According to Skeptoid, almost nobody actually believes it is a real creature and its backstory is unremarkable, yet it has a prodigious community of supporters likely to keep growing.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Skeptoid, hampir tidak ada orang yang sungguh percaya makhluk ini nyata dan latar ceritanya tidak istimewa, namun ia punya komunitas pendukung besar yang kemungkinan terus bertambah.
claims.quote: The Fresno Nightcrawler is supported by little or no actual belief by anyone that it's a real creature; there's nothing particularly thought-provoking in its backstory; and yet, it has a prodigious community of supporters that is only likely to continue growing.

claims.statement: The gallinipper is a cryptid of African-American folk tradition.
claims.statement_id: Gallinipper adalah kriptid dalam tradisi rakyat Afrika-Amerika.
claims.quote: The gallinipper is a cryptid in the African-American folk tradition.

claims.statement: They were said to be giant mosquitoes whose bones could fence a 140-acre field.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini konon nyamuk raksasa yang tulangnya cukup untuk memagari ladang seluas 140 acre.
claims.quote: These creatures were said to be a species of giant mosquitoes so big that their bones could fence a 140-acre (57 ha) field.

claims.statement: In a popular telling it pulls its bill from a tree trunk, clearing 140 acres in the struggle.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah populer, makhluk ini menarik paruhnya dari batang pohon dan membersihkan lahan 140 acre selama meronta.
claims.quote: A popular telling of the legends has the creature get its bill out of a tree trunk, with the animal being large enough to clear 140 acres of land during the struggle.

claims.statement: Gallinipper tales were taken up in minstrel shows and appear in blues songs such as "Mosquito Moan" by Blind Lemon Jefferson.
claims.statement_id: Kisah gallinipper diambil untuk pertunjukan minstrel, tetapi juga muncul dalam lagu blues seperti "Mosquito Moan" karya Blind Lemon Jefferson.
claims.quote: Gallinipper tales were appropriated as a feature of minstrel shows, but have also appeared in American blues songs such as "Mosquito Moan" by Blind Lemon Jefferson

claims.statement: According to Merriam-Webster, gallinipper is chiefly Southern US and Midland US usage for any of various insects, such as a large mosquito or crane fly.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Merriam-Webster, gallinipper dipakai terutama di Southern US dan Midland US untuk berbagai serangga, seperti nyamuk besar (large mosquito) atau crane fly.
claims.quote: chiefly Southern US and Midland US : any of various insects (such as a large mosquito or crane fly)

claims.statement: Merriam-Webster records the earlier forms gurnipper and gal-knipper, and says the word is of obscure origin.
claims.statement_id: Merriam-Webster mencatat bentuk yang lebih awal gurnipper dan gal-knipper, dan asal katanya tidak jelas.
claims.quote: earlier gurnipper, gal-knipper, of obscure origin

claims.statement: Fauset records a short tale in which the narrator says a gallinipper came after him down Mobile way, ran behind a tree and through it, and he clinched it on the other side.
claims.statement_id: Fauset mencatat sebuah kisah singkat: seorang penutur mengaku seekor gallinipper mengejarnya di daerah Mobile, berlari di balik pohon dan menembus pohon itu, lalu ia mendekapnya dari sisi lain.
claims.quote: A gallinipper come after me down Mobile way. He run behind that tree. The gallinipper come th’oo the tree. I clinched on the other side. I had him.

claims.statement: Gaoh (also Ga-oh) is a wind spirit and giant of the Haudenosaunee, Wendat and Seneca.
claims.statement_id: Gaoh (juga Ga-oh) adalah roh angin dan raksasa orang Haudenosaunee, Wendat, dan Seneca.
claims.quote: Gaoh, Ga-oh or Gǎ-oh is a wind spirit and giant of the Haudenosaunee, Wendat and Seneca people.

claims.statement: Gaoh was described as a cannibal giant who could uproot trees, taking the form of a solitary old man.
claims.statement_id: Gaoh digambarkan sebagai raksasa kanibal yang dapat mencabut pohon, berwujud lelaki tua yang menyendiri.
claims.quote: Gaoh was described as a cannibal and a giant who could uproot trees. He takes the form of a solitary old man.

claims.statement: Gaoh is subservient to the Great Spirit and, in Haudenosaunee mythology, to Adekagagwaa.
claims.statement_id: Gaoh tunduk kepada Roh Agung, dan dalam mitologi Haudenosaunee ia tunduk kepada Adekagagwaa.
claims.quote: Gaoh is subservient to the Great Spirit, and in Haudenosaunee mythology he is subservient to Adekagagwaa.

claims.statement: Gaoh is mostly benevolent but can be restless and violent, creating storms.
claims.statement_id: Gaoh umumnya roh baik, tetapi bisa gelisah, ganas, dan menciptakan badai.
claims.quote: Gaoh is mostly a benevolent spirit, but can be restless and violent, and would create storms.

claims.statement: From his home he controls the seasons and the winds of the four directions.
claims.statement_id: Dari rumahnya, ia mengendalikan musim dan angin dari empat penjuru mata angin.
claims.quote: From his home, he controls the seasons, and also winds of the four cardinal directions

claims.statement: His winds are Ya-o-gah (Bear, north), Da-jo-ji (Panther, west), O-yan-do-ne (Moose, east) and Ne-o-gah (Fawn, south).
claims.statement_id: Angin-anginnya adalah Ya-o-gah (beruang angin utara), Da-jo-ji (macan kumbang angin barat), O-yan-do-ne (rusa besar angin timur), dan Ne-o-gah (anak rusa angin selatan).
claims.quote: Ya-o-gah ... or Bear of the north wind, Da-jo-ji ... or Panther of the west wind, O-yan-do-ne ... or Moose of the east wind and Ne-o-gah ... or Fawn of the south wind.

claims.statement: In the Seneca version, Gaoh is chained to a rock, and winds blow when he tries to break free.
claims.statement_id: Dalam versi Seneca, Gaoh dirantai ke batu, dan angin bertiup saat ia berusaha melepaskan diri.
claims.quote: In the Seneca version of the myth, Gaoh is chained to a rock, and winds would blow when he attempts to break free.

claims.statement: Though of giant proportions, Ga-oh, who governs the winds, is confined in the broad north sky.
claims.statement_id: Meski bertubuh raksasa, Ga-oh, yang menguasai angin, dikurung di langit utara yang luas.
claims.quote: Though of giant proportions, Ga-oh ... who governs the winds, is confined in the broad north sky.

claims.statement: Were Ga-oh free, he would tear the heavens into fragments.
claims.statement_id: Seandainya Ga-oh bebas, ia akan mencabik langit menjadi serpihan.
claims.quote: Were Ga-oh free, he would tear the heavens into fragments.

claims.statement: Ga-oh is not an evil being, however his four winds may rage; on the contrary he is solicitous for the welfare of men and ever obedient to the commands of the Creator.
claims.statement_id: Ga-oh bukan makhluk jahat, seganas apa pun keempat anginnya; sebaliknya ia peduli pada kesejahteraan manusia dan selalu menaati perintah Sang Pencipta.
claims.quote: Ga-oh is not an evil being, howsoever his four winds may rage, but on the contrary, solicitous for the welfare of men and ever obedient to the commands of the Creator.

claims.statement: In a footnote the writer states, from her researches, that Ga-oh dwells in the west sky, agreeing with Morgan, who names the western sky as the abode of the wind spirit and calls his dwelling Da-yo-da-do-go-wa.
claims.statement_id: Dalam catatan kaki, penulis menyatakan berdasarkan penelitiannya bahwa Ga-oh tinggal di langit barat, sejalan dengan Morgan yang menyebut langit barat sebagai tempat tinggal roh angin dan menamai kediamannya Da-yo-da-do-go-wa.
claims.quote: Ga-oh dwells in the west sky according to the researches of the writer, agreeing with Morgan who names the western sky as the abode of the wind spirit and calls his dwelling Da-yo-da-do-go-wa.

claims.statement: At the entrance of his abode are four watchers: the Bear (north wind), Panther (west wind), Moose (east wind) and Fawn (south wind).
claims.statement_id: Di pintu kediamannya ada empat penjaga: Beruang (angin utara), Macan Kumbang (angin barat), Rusa Besar (angin timur), dan Anak Rusa (angin selatan).
claims.quote: the Bear (north wind). Panther (west wind). Moose (east wind), and Fawn (south wind).

claims.statement: When Ga-oh is contented and happy, gentle and invigorating breezes fan Earth.
claims.statement_id: Ketika Ga-oh puas dan bahagia, angin sepoi-sepoi yang lembut dan menyegarkan berembus ke Bumi.
claims.quote: When Ga-oh is contented and happy, gentle and invigorating breezes fan Earth

claims.statement: A footnote says that Ga-oh is the name of the wind spirit according to Morgan.
claims.statement_id: Dalam catatan kaki disebutkan bahwa Ga-oh adalah nama roh angin menurut Morgan.
claims.quote: Ga-oh is the name of the wind spirit according to Morgan.

claims.statement: Depending on the myths, he either lives in a house in the sky or in a mountain cave called "the House of Winds."
claims.statement_id: Tergantung mitosnya, ia tinggal di rumah di langit atau di gua gunung bernama "Rumah Angin".
claims.quote: Depending on the myths, he either lives in a house in the sky, or a mountain cave called "the House of Winds."

claims.statement: Some versions of the myths describe the winds as the guardians of Gaoh's home, while others describe them as locked up in his home, to be released once Gaoh receives the order from the Great Spirit.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian versi mitos menggambarkan angin sebagai penjaga rumah Gaoh, sementara versi lain menggambarkan angin terkunci di rumahnya dan akan dilepaskan setelah Gaoh menerima perintah dari Roh Agung.
claims.quote: Some versions of the myths describe the winds as the guardians of Gaoh's home, while others describe the winds being locked up in his home, who were to be released once Gaoh receives the order from the Great Spirit.

claims.statement: Guahaioque was a minor deity of the Muisca religion, god of evil, stealing, lies and death.
claims.statement_id: Guahaioque adalah dewa minor dalam agama Muisca, dewa kejahatan, pencurian, kebohongan, dan kematian.
claims.quote: Guahaioque was a minor deity in the religion of the Muisca. It was the god of evil, stealing, lies and death.

claims.statement: In the Muisca language, Muysccubun, the name means "figure of the deceased".
claims.statement_id: Dalam bahasa Muisca, Muysccubun, nama Guahaioque berarti "sosok orang yang telah meninggal".
claims.quote: The name Guahaioque in the language of the Muisca, Muysccubun, means "figure of the deceased".

claims.statement: The name lives on as that of a folk metal band from Cali.
claims.statement_id: Nama Guahaioque kini dipakai oleh sebuah band folk metal dari Cali.
claims.quote: The name Guahaioque lives on as the name of a folk metal band from Cali.

claims.statement: The Muysca-Spanish dictionary defines guahaioque as a noun meaning "demonio, diablo" (literally "figura de difunto").
claims.statement_id: Kamus Muysca-Spanyol mendefinisikan guahaioque sebagai kata benda yang berarti "demonio, diablo" (secara harfiah "figura de difunto").
claims.quote: I. s. Demonio, diablo ( lit. "figura de difunto". )

claims.statement: The dictionary cites a manuscript identified as Ms. 158 (Voc.), in which "demonio" is rendered guahaioque (fol. 53r) and "diablo" guhaioque (fol. 59r).
claims.statement_id: Kamus mengutip naskah yang disebut Ms. 158 (Voc.), tempat "demonio" dipadankan dengan guahaioque (fol. 53r) dan "diablo" dengan guhaioque (fol. 59r).
claims.quote: Demonio = guahaioque = [sic] (Gómez & Torres, 2013) - Ms. 158. Voc. fol. 53r Diablo = guhaioque = [sic] (Gómez & Torres, 2013) - Ms. 158. Voc. fol. 59r

claims.statement: The dictionary entry gives the spellings guahaioque and guhaioque and the morphological analysis guahaia-uque.
claims.statement_id: Entri kamus memuat ejaan guahaioque dan guhaioque serta uraian morfologis guahaia-uque.
claims.quote: guahaioque, guhaioque Fon. Gonz.*/ɣuahaioke/ Cons. */ɣuahaioke/ Morf. guahaia-uque

claims.statement: Guaraci or Quaraci (from Tupi kûarasý, "sun") is the Sun god of Guaraní mythology, creator of all living creatures.
claims.statement_id: Guaraci atau Quaraci (dari kata Tupi kûarasý, "matahari") adalah dewa Matahari dalam mitologi Guaraní, pencipta semua makhluk hidup.
claims.quote: Guaraci or Quaraci (from Tupi kûarasý, "sun") in the Guaraní mythology is the god of the Sun, creator of all living creatures.

claims.statement: According to Cascudo, Coaraci is the Sun in the Tupi or Nheengatu language, from coá "this", ara "day" and ci "mother": "mother of this day", "mother of the day", the explanation of the origin of daylight.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Cascudo, Coaraci adalah Matahari dalam bahasa Tupi atau nheengatu, dari coá "ini", ara "hari", dan ci "ibu": "ibu hari ini", "ibu sang hari", penjelasan asal cahaya siang.
claims.quote: Coaraci. O Sol no idioma tupi, ou nheengatu. De coá, este, ara dia, ci, mãe deste dia, mãe do dia, a explica- ção da origem da luz diurna.

claims.statement: In the Guaraci entry, Cascudo writes that Couto de Magalhães, who devised an indigenous theogony, stated that the Sun is the creator of all living things, in charge of directing the animal kingdom.
claims.statement_id: Dalam verbet Guaraci, Cascudo menulis bahwa Couto de Magalhães, yang menyusun sebuah teogoni pribumi, menyatakan Matahari adalah pencipta semua makhluk hidup dan bertugas memimpin dunia hewan.
claims.quote: Guaraci. Couto de Magalhães, que arquitetara uma teogonia indígena, escreveu que o Sol é o criador de todos os viventes, encarregado de dirigir o reino animal

claims.statement: In that theogony, subject to Coaraci live Anhangá, protecting the game of the open field, Caapora, that of the forest, Guirapuru, the birds, and Uauiará, the fish.
claims.statement_id: Dalam teogoni itu, di bawah Coaraci hidup Anhangá yang melindungi buruan padang, Caapora yang melindungi buruan hutan, Guirapuru yang melindungi burung, dan Uauiará yang melindungi ikan.
claims.quote: Sujeitos a Coaraci, com o domí- nio sobre os seres privativos de sua jurisdição, vivem Anhangá, protegen- do a caça do campo, Caapora, a do mato, Guirapuru, os pássaros, Uauia- rá, os peixes.

claims.statement: In that theogony, Coaraci's sister and wife is Jaci, the Moon, who likewise has her court with functions identical to her brother's.
claims.statement_id: Dalam teogoni itu, saudari sekaligus istri Coaraci adalah Jaci, sang Bulan, yang juga memiliki istana dengan fungsi yang sama dengan saudaranya.
claims.quote: A irmã e esposa do Coa- raci é Jaci, a Lua, tendo semelhante- mente sua corte, com funções idênti- cas às do seu irmão.

claims.statement: Cascudo writes that there are no traces supporting the existence of an astral cult among the indigenous peoples of Brazil, and that they had no devotion to the Sun.
claims.statement_id: Cascudo menulis bahwa tidak ada jejak yang mendukung adanya pemujaan benda langit di kalangan masyarakat pribumi Brasil, dan bahwa mereka tidak memiliki pengabdian apa pun kepada Matahari.
claims.quote: Não há vestígios que fundarmentem a existência de um culto astrolátrico entre os indígenas do Brasil. Os indígenas nenhuma de- voção possuíam para o Sol

claims.statement: According to Cascudo, Stradelli says the form Coraci was heard pronounced in Pará and the lower Amazon.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Cascudo, Stradelli mengatakan bentuk Coraci terdengar diucapkan di Pará dan Amazonas hilir.
claims.quote: Stradelli diz que se ouvia pronunciar Coraci no Pará e baixo Amazonas.

claims.statement: In the Jaci entry, Cascudo describes Jaci as sister and wife of the Sun in the indigenous theogony, the Sun being named Coaraci, Coraci, Goaraci or Gorazi.
claims.statement_id: Dalam verbet Jaci, Cascudo menyebut Jaci sebagai saudari dan istri sang Matahari dalam teogoni pribumi, dengan nama Coaraci, Coraci, Goaraci, atau Gorazi.
claims.quote: Na teogonia indígena era irmã e ca- sada com o Sol, Coaraci, Coraci, Goa- raci, Gorazi.

claims.quote: (KARSTEN, Indian Tribes of Equador, P. 70.)

claims.statement: Karsten writes that the anaconda is the principal and most feared of all the demons that people the spiritual world of the Ecuadorian Indians, and that it is the father of witchcraft.
claims.statement_id: Karsten menulis bahwa anakonda adalah yang utama dan paling ditakuti di antara semua iblis yang mendiami dunia roh orang Indian Ekuador, dan bahwa ia adalah bapak ilmu sihir.
claims.quote: The anaconda, in fact, is the principal and the most feared of all the demons that people the spiritual world of the Ecuadorian Indians. He is the father of witchcraft.

claims.statement: Karsten writes that the souls of medicine-men are supposed to be able to transmigrate into the anaconda, both after death and in life, and that when the Indians kill such a monster they say they have killed an evil sorcerer.
claims.statement_id: Karsten menulis bahwa jiwa para dukun dianggap dapat berpindah ke dalam anakonda, baik setelah mati maupun semasa hidup, dan bahwa orang Indian yang membunuh makhluk itu mengatakan telah membunuh seorang dukun jahat.
claims.quote: Both after death and in their lifetime the souls of the medicine-men are supposed to be able to transmigrate into the anaconda; and when the Indians kill such a monster they say that they have killed an evil sorcerer.
